fishing: WHEN: Monday evening Oct 5. Port Boca Grande high 8:19a (1.9 ft), low 4:10p (0.3 ft), high 11:39p (1.4 ft). Lemon Bay sunrise/sunset about 7:23a / 7:11p; evening window 5:41p-7:41p. SE/S 5-10 kt becoming SW, light chop, no organized storms. Snook harvest open in Charlotte Harbor / SW through Nov 30 (slot 28-33, 1/day). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 — redfish and snook on shoreline edges of the trough; ladyfish, bluefish and trout mixed in, not a hot surf day. Stump Pass islands still the earlier hold; Spanish were just outside the pass. LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; a few trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: West Wall south half lots of redfish, snook picked up after the weak front (treeline, deeper cuts). Mangrove snapper fewer but bigger toward Placida; gag grouper season open. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report is June (summer tarpon); no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, white bait, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach and Stump Pass. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/4). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory. Charlotte beaches page all Good.
fpl: Evening check: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
